steps.content: [Altar - Upper Half]

steps.speaker: Praying Voices
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>May wishes find their end... may longing find its anchor... may souls find their vessel...

steps.speaker: Praying Voices
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>May wishes find their end... may longing find its anchor... may souls find their vessel...
Guided by the shackles, you step deeper into the lantern sea, the air thick with low, indistinct chanting.

Lichen should be here. But everywhere you look, there are only the soul lanterns, cyan and countless, suspended at every height and swaying softly. They stretch from where you stand to the very limit of sight.

You can't help but study each lantern as you pass. They're made of paper, and the pale cyan glow within throws wavering human silhouettes across their surfaces, flickering frame by frame like a shadow play.
The faces bear no eyes or noses, only a split where a mouth should be, stretched open in what might be a grin.

Figures kneel and slam their heads against the ground. Once, twice, three times... Their skulls have already collapsed, no longer recognizable, just swollen lumps of ruined flesh. They feel nothing and carry on anyway, bowing until those lumps flatten entirely and stick to the earth.

Candles burn in their bare hands, the fire climbing and consuming each finger in turn. The hands dissolve slowly, like tallow, meat and bone blending into a shapeless drip of grease. The flames, nourished, only rise higher.
Each figure has a bowl set before them. With small blades, they gash their palms and let the liquid trickle out, but the bowl never fills. Their hands are no longer hands, just unrecognizable ruin.
In that lantern, you see yourself.
Faceless, but unmistakably you: same frame, same clothes. He kneels low before the stone statues and monsters you've seen along the road.
steps.female_content: Faceless, but unmistakably you: same frame, same clothes. She kneels low before the stone statues and monsters you've seen along the road.

steps.content: His spine is curved into a posture of submission you've never worn, skull hanging heavy under an unseen burden.
steps.female_content: Her spine is curved into a posture of submission you've never worn, skull hanging heavy under an unseen burden.

steps.content: Abruptly, his head snaps toward you.
steps.female_content: Abruptly, her head snaps toward you.

steps.speaker: You?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>It's your turn...

steps.speaker: You?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Make your offering... and your wish shall be granted...
[White Flash]

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...Don't touch anything here.
A hand bats your arm down softly. You snap out of it and notice, with a jolt, how close your hand had reached toward the lantern.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: That is where we need to go.
You lift your eyes in the direction he's looking. From the crown of every lantern, fine red threads stretch upward, all of them arcing toward a vast sphere suspended at the heart of the lantern sea.
The closer you come, the harder the shackles tug, until you're standing right before the stone sphere.
Countless crimson threads are lashed around it, and the giant heart beats with a slow, steady rhythm, as if alive.
Overhead, a wound in the fabric of the world yawns open and snaps shut, over and over. With each pulse, it breathes out a gust of damp, decayed air that hits your skin.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Without rules... nothing holds its shape...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Let... everything... return to the right path...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Do not walk toward... the ending... you fear most...
Something speaks, and the sound crawls into your brain like a damp parasite, sliding past every defense.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: ...rules... right path...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: ...ending... fear...
...Are these words meant for you?
In your daze, the logic feels sound: uphold the rules of the Void of Yin, restore the proper order, and only then...
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Your wish shall be granted.
[Transition 1s + sound of a sword being drawn]

A shrill screech of metal grinds through the whisper, reducing it to a formless hum. You snap back to awareness. Chengxiao is gazing down at the blade in his grip, its edge gleaming cold under the cyan lantern light.
His head hangs low, as if listening to something.
Around him, an unsteady surge of Mania begins to coil and churn. You edge a careful step toward him.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Chengxiao?
He doesn't answer right away, his hand gripping the hilt tightly.
Then, after a few seconds, he pulls in a deep breath and lets his fingers fall loose.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...Mm. What is it?
He draws himself upright again, still not meeting your eyes, his attention locked on the sphere ahead. But the surge of Mania has quieted. For the moment, at least.
You shake your head, rattling the last of the hum from your skull, and force your eyes to lock onto the sphere.
It rests in the tight grip of a pedestal, and the base is buried deep into the sludge below. Both are cast in the same cold, hard grey stone, much like the steles you first saw in the Void of Yin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This doesn't look like something Lichen could have made.
Perhaps she used those wishes and corrupted the wandering dead, but this stone sculpture is anchored in something far older.
A string of unfamiliar cyan glyphs drifts above the pedestal's surface.
<color=#11F0F0><b><i>Will and longing are born entwined, tethered to form.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Li Xianling... you've really taken it this far...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You've gone too far... and I couldn't stop you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What does it say? What is she actually trying to do?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This is the "truth" the Void of Yin has left for us.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Guide people to repeat the ritual, strengthen their faith, and they will manifest here in the Void of Yin as wandering souls.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Then, with an artifact to bind and stabilize those souls, one can bring something new into being.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: And as for the artifact... we have one right here in front of us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So that's why she's been controlling those phantoms. That's why she came here. She wants to gather all those phantoms and fuse them into something stronger...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But could something like that really bring a person back from the dead...?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: What Li Xianling truly wants is to create, with her own hands, a divine savior, a god that can save the world. Something to stand against the calamities.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But how could anything made from these wandering souls be a savior?
After all, almost everything in the Void of Yin is, in one way or another, a creation of Mania.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Of course it couldn't. It would be nothing more than a monster, no different from the <color=#fb9259>calamities</color> themselves.

Tied to the <color=#fb9259>DisSea</color>, a monster no different from the <color=#fb9259>calamities</color> themselves... Something stirs at the back of your mind, a half-formed recollection of a similar being that you know far too well...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Apostles of Ashes</color> are products of concentrated Mania, a material projection of collective consciousness. They manifest themselves in this world, in the forms of disasters and Wraith Beasts.

If what's forming is truly an <color=#fb9259>Apostle of Ashes</color>, and it breaches Maria City with no Hypercubes to counter it, the result would be annihilation on a scale the people of that age could never endure.
Everyone here will die.
<b>You have to stop its birth now!
Your fingertips barely graze the sphere when glyphs erupt, multiplying and elongating into unrecognizable forms. They twist and knot together like a swarm of insect legs gnawing at each other.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: "Will and longing are born entwined, tethered to form"...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ..."When form is masterless, every desire seeks its own path."
She raises her eyes to the pillar, where the same cyan glyphs flicker in frantic bursts.
A sound descends from overhead, a visceral thrum as if drawn from the lungs of something enormous and ancient. It swells, louder and louder.
The sphere shudders, convulsing against its pedestal as though fighting to tear itself free. From within the black maw of the void, a shape becomes darker and more solid by the second.

<color=#11F0F0><b><i>Will and longing are born entwined, tethered to form. 
When form is masterless, every desire seeks its own path.
Every soul lantern goes dark in the same breath. Absolute blackness crashes down around you.
Then the void pulses, swelling in rhythm with your own heartbeat, turns into a form of pure chaos. It's something beyond anything you've ever witnessed, and it hurls itself at you.
